channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont drivers should prepare for more road work starting Monday. Projects on I-eighty-nine, Vermont fourteen, and other highways will cause lane closures and slowdowns. Officials urge caution and patience through these construction zones to keep everyone safe.

WhistlePig Whiskey is pushing back against New York's demand for an air permit. They dispute findings of whiskey fungus near their Mineville warehouses and say controls could cost over twenty-five million dollars. The DEC is reviewing their response but has made no further comment.

Rutland is updating the way it replaces police cruisers, now factoring in idling time as part of mileage wear. One hour of idling equals thirty miles of driving, officials say. The policy change awaits final approval by the city and state.

Vermont State Police are looking for two suspects who stole an ATM from a Pittsford gas station. The theft happened early Sunday morning at Champlain Farms. Police released photos and urge anyone with information to contact them immediately.
